_about: The declared credential families. A family groups canonical titles that stay their own titles: each member keeps its identity, its adoption and its exhibits, and carries the family as a field (kb_curation credential_family, carried into kb/credentials.json by kb/_apply_credential_review.py). Each member's component tests are search aliases of it (kb/credential_aliases.py components). A family is never a fold target. Sam's ruling, 2026-11-11 (cpl_memory sam-bundle-family-is-a-field-2026-11-11).
_owner: kb/_family_tag_plan.py and the Quick Adopt family worker (S638); other readers only read it
